features.name: Portfolio Diversification Index
features.description: Measures cross-sectional dispersion of stock returns within the portfolio over a fixed time window, serving as a proxy for diversification effectiveness.
procedure: For each stock, compute 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns from div_adj_close
Sort stocks by date and company
Calculate cross-sectional standard deviation of these individual volatilities across all stocks with valid data
Take equal-weight mean of cross-sectional standard deviations for the portfolio
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate greater dispersion in risk contributions across stocks, suggesting lower diversification effectiveness.

features.name: Market Leadership Concentration Score
features.description: Quantifies the fraction of stocks contributing above-average returns within the portfolio over a fixed period.
procedure: For each stock, compute 10-day rolling return from div_adj_close
Calculate portfolio-level mean return for the same window
Count number of stocks with returns exceeding the portfolio mean
Divide count by total number of stocks to get fraction
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more concentrated leadership (fewer stocks driving performance).

features.name: Momentum Shift Frequency
features.description: Counts the number of times portfolio momentum crosses zero threshold in a fixed window.
procedure: Compute 5-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate portfolio-level mean return for each day
Count transitions between positive and negative returns in the portfolio mean over 60-day window
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more frequent momentum regime shifts.

features.name: Volatility Regime Stability
features.description: Measures consistency of volatility clustering patterns in the portfolio over time.
procedure: Calculate 20-day rolling standard deviation of returns from div_adj_close for each stock
Compute portfolio-level mean volatility for each day
Count number of times mean volatility crosses upper/lower thresholds (e.g., ±1.5σ) over 60-day window
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more unstable volatility patterns.

features.name: Portfolio Regime Transition Frequency
features.description: Counts transitions between bull and bear market states defined by cumulative returns.
procedure: Compute 60-day cumulative return from div_adj_close for each stock
Define bull state as cumulative return > 5%, bear state as < -3%
Count transitions between these states in portfolio-level mean over 120-day window
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more frequent regime shifts.

features.name: Systematic Risk Amplification Index
features.description: Measures average pairwise correlation between stock returns in the portfolio.
procedure: Compute 20-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate pairwise correlations between all stocks with valid data
Take equal-weight mean of all pairwise correlations
features.interpretation: Higher positive values indicate greater systematic risk amplification.

features.name: Recovery Velocity Index
features.description: Measures time required to recover from maximum drawdown in the portfolio.
procedure: Compute 60-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate portfolio-level minimum cumulative return (drawdown) over window
Measure number of days needed to recover to pre-drawdown level
features.interpretation: Lower values indicate faster recovery from drawdowns.

features.name: Liquidity Correlation Intensity
features.description: Measures synchronization of trading volume changes across portfolio stocks.
procedure: Compute 10-day rolling standard deviation of volume for each stock
Calculate pairwise correlations between these volatility measures
Take equal-weight mean of all pairwise correlations
features.interpretation: Higher positive values indicate synchronized liquidity shocks.

features.name: Sentiment Coherence Score
features.description: Measures alignment between portfolio returns and volume trends as proxies for sentiment.
procedure: Compute 10-day rolling return from div_adj_close and volume change for each stock
Calculate correlation between these two metrics across all stocks
Take equal-weight mean of correlations
features.interpretation: Higher positive values indicate stronger alignment between price and volume trends.

features.name: Risk Contribution Uniformity Index
features.description: Measures standard deviation of individual stock volatilities within the portfolio.
procedure: Compute 20-day rolling standard deviation of returns from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate cross-sectional standard deviation of these values across all stocks
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate less uniform risk contribution across stocks.

features.name: Portfolio Regime Adaptability Index
features.description: Measures difference in portfolio returns between high and low volatility states.
procedure: Compute 60-day rolling standard deviation of returns from div_adj_close for each stock
Define high volatility as >1.5σ, low volatility as <0.5σ
Calculate mean return in both states and take absolute difference
features.interpretation: Lower values indicate more consistent performance across regimes.

features.name: Information Flow Dominance Metric
features.description: Measures correlation between portfolio returns and trading volume as proxies for information flow.
procedure: Compute 10-day rolling return from div_adj_close and log(volume) change for each stock
Calculate cross-sectional correlation between these two metrics
features.interpretation: Higher positive values indicate stronger information flow dominance.

features.name: Dynamic Correlation Stability
features.description: Measures standard deviation of pairwise stock correlations over time.
procedure: Compute 20-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate pairwise correlations between all stocks with valid data
Measure standard deviation of these correlations across the window
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate less stable inter-stock relationships.

features.name: Tail Risk Exposure Concentration
features.description: Measures cross-sectional dispersion of returns during extreme market events.
procedure: Compute 60-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Identify bottom 10% of stocks by return (tail risk contributors)
Calculate standard deviation of returns among these tail-risk stocks
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more concentrated tail risk exposure.

features.name: Portfolio Entropy of Returns
features.description: Measures unpredictability in the distribution of portfolio returns.
procedure: Compute 60-day rolling return from div_adj_close for each stock
Calculate probability density function of these returns
Apply Shannon entropy formula to the distribution
features.interpretation: Higher values indicate more chaotic/unordered return patterns.
